αἰδῶ: αἰδώς — shame, sense of shame; fem. acc. sg.; of what is covered, ’the shame’, i.e. the private parts
αἰνὸν: αἰνός — dread, fearsome, grim; neut. nom./acc. sg. (αἰνὸν ἄχος ’fearsome grief’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with κότον: ’grim’ (κότον αἰνὸν ’grim resentment’)
αἰνῇ: αἰνός — dread, grim, terrible; fem. dat. sg., agreeing with δηϊοτῆτι
αἴδεο: αἰδέομαι — respect, show regard for; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted -εο (= Attic αἰδοῦ): ’show respect to’

αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg., reinforcing a pronoun: ’me myself’ (ἔμ’ αὐτὸν) · also plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν ’beside him’) · also intensive, with the object already named by a pronoun: ’you yourself’ (σε … αὐτὸν δὲ κλαίοντα ’you yourself, weeping’) · also plain personal pronoun as direct object: ’him’ (αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’they set upon him’) · also intensive, standing for the subject of an infinitive: ’himself’ (αὐτὸν δ’ … μάχεσθαι ’and himself to fight’) · also intensive, agreeing with a noun: ’himself’ (αὐτὸν βασιλῆα ’the king himself’) · also plain personal pronoun, direct object with no preposition: ’him’ (αὐτὸν ἐπαΐξαντες ἕλοιμεν ’rushing on, we could take him’)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg., intensive with the subject: ’myself, yourself, himself’
αὖθ: αὖθις (elided αὖθ’) — again, in turn, next; adv., epic by-form αὖθι (cf. αὖτε) · also αὖθι elided: ’there, on the spot’ (αὖθ’ ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’right there at the ditch’)

γέροντος: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. gen. sg. (ἁλίοιο γέροντος ’of the old man of the sea’)
γέρων: γέρων — old man; masc. nom. sg.
γαίῃ: γαῖα — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic γαίᾳ)
γαῖαν: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. acc. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γούνατ: γόνυ — knee; neut. acc. pl., elided (γούνατ’ = γούνατα); ’loosen the knees’ means ’kill, unstring’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject of a verb of motion: ’(my) knees’ (γούνατα ὀρώρῃ) · also neut. nom. pl., subject of a passive: ’(the) knees are hampered’ (γούνατα βλάβεται) · also neut. acc. pl., object of ἐδάμνα in tmesis with ὑπό: ’(weariness) overcame the knees’ (ὑπὸ γούνατ’ ἐδάμνα)
γυναικῶν: γυνή — woman; fem. gen. pl., partitive after δῖα: ’the divine one among women’ · also fem. gen. pl., dependent on χερσί: ’of the women’ · also fem. gen. pl. after πρό: ’in defence of the wives’ (πρὸ γυναικῶν ’in front of, for their wives’) · also fem. gen. pl., dependent on φῦλα: ’tribes of women’ · also fem. gen. pl., in apposition to ἀνθρώπων with ἀνδρῶν: ’of women’ · also fem. gen. pl., with ἤτε … ἤτε, dependent on θέμις: ’of men or of women’ (θέμις … ἀνδρῶν ἤτε γυναικῶν) · also fem. gen. pl. after περί: ’for the women’ (περὶ … γυναικῶν) · also fem. gen. pl., of origin after ἐξεγένοντο: ’of women’ (ἐξεγένοντο γυναικῶν ’were born of women’)

δάκρυ: δάκρυ — tear, tears; neut. acc. sg., object of χέω: ’shedding tears’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’a tear’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of ἀπομόρξατο ’wiped away’

δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δήϊον: δήϊος — hostile, destructive (of war or a foe); masc./neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic δήιος)
δίψαν: δίψα — thirst; fem. acc. sg., object of ἀφέτην: ’put away thirst’
δαμείς: δάμνημι (δαμάζω) — overpower, subdue; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’overcome’
δειλοῖσι: δειλός — wretched, miserable; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
δεῦρο: δεῦρο — hither, to this place; adv.
δηϊοτῆτι: δηϊοτής — hostile fighting, battle (δήϊος ’hostile’); fem. dat. sg., epic
δόμοισιν: δόμος — house, home; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), plural for a single dwelling
δύναμίς: δύναμις — power, strength; fem. nom. sg., extra accent on the last syllable before the enclitic γε
δύναμαι: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 1 sg. mid./pass. dep., + inf.: ’I am able’
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle

εἰμι: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 sg., enclitic (accent goes to the word before): ’I am’
εἰν: ἐν (epic εἰν) — in, among; prep. + dat.
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.

εἴ: εἰ — if, whether; accented εἴ before an enclitic (εἴ κεν, εἴ ποτε, εἴ περ)
εἶσιν: εἶμι — go; pres. 3 sg., ν-movable (= Attic εἶσι(ν)): ’goes’
ζώουσι: ζώω — live, be alive, prosper; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ζῶσι)
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before a rough breathing) — and; connective particle
θάνῃς: θνῄσκω — die; aor. subj. 2 sg. (stem θαν-), after αἴ κε: ’if you die’
θέοντος: θέω — run; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., agreeing with τοῦ: ’as he ran’
θανόντι: θνῄσκω — die; aor. part. act. masc. dat. sg.: ’(for one) dead’
θεοῖσι: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic θεοῖς)

θεὸν: θεός — god; masc. acc. sg. · also fem. acc. sg. of a goddess (θεός is common gender): ’goddess’ (δεινὴν … θεόν ’a fearsome goddess’)
θνητὸς: θνητός — mortal, subject to death; masc. nom. sg.

θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θύρῃσιν: θύρα — door; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic θύραις): ’at the doors’
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also εἰ … κ’ + subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ · also ἐπεί κ’ + aor. subj., prospective temporal: ’when, once’ · also εἰς ὅ κ’ + opt., ’until … should’ · also κ’ + opt., potential: ’would’ (οὐδέ κ’ … ὀνόσαιτ’ ’nor would … make light of’) · also εἴ … κ’ + fut. indic. in a condition: ’if … shall’ (εἴ κ’ … ἑλκήσουσιν ’if … drag’) · also κ’ + aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (ἦ κ’ ἐδάμην ’I would have been subdued’) · also κ’ + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὁπποῖόν κ’ εἴπῃσθα ’whatever sort you say’)

κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also with an aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κέν … κατέπαυσε ’would have stopped’) · also with αἴ + subj. in a condition: ’if perhaps … can’ · also with the opt., potential: ’could, would’ (πῶς κέν τις ἀκούσαι ’how could anyone hear’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὅτε: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κέν τις … βάλῃ ’whenever someone hits’) · also ἤ κέν + subj. κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. as a noun: ’evils’ · also neut. acc. pl., adj. with ἔργα: ’evil (deeds)’
κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil, harmful; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., ’a coward, a base man’ (κακὸν ὣς δειδίσσεσθαι ’to frighten like a coward’) · also masc. acc. sg., adj. with a noun: ’evil’ (κακὸν οἶτον ’an evil doom’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate noun: ’an evil’ · also neut. nom. sg., adj. with ὄναρ: ’evil (dream)’ · also neut. nom. sg. as a noun, subject: ’evil’ (κακὸν κακῷ ’evil upon evil’)
καλέουσι: καλέω — call, name; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλοῦσι)
καλὰ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. acc. pl. as an adverb, with a negative: ’not well’ (οὐ … καλὰ ’not fairly’) · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔντεα: ’fine (gear)’

κείμενον: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λίθον: ’lying’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σάκος: ’lying’
κεκλιμένοι: κλίνω — lean, recline; perf. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. pl., + dat.: ’leaning (on)’
κεφαλὴν: κεφαλή — head; fem. acc. sg., acc. of respect · also fem. acc. sg., direct object of a verb of lifting: ’head’ · also fem. acc. sg., object of κόψεν: ’head’ (κεφαλὴν … ἀπὸ δειρῆς κόψεν ’cut the head from the neck’) · also fem. acc. sg., object of πῆξαι and of ταμόντα: ’head’ · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἐνεῖκαι ’bring’: ’head’ · also fem. acc. sg., after κὰκ of the place struck: ’on the head’
κεῖσθαι: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; pres. inf. mid. dep.: ’to lie’
κλίναντες: κλίνω — lean, rest; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having leaned, having rested’
κρονίδης: Κρονίδης — son of Cronus (Zeus); masc. nom. sg., patronymic
κταμένοιο: κτείνω — kill; root aor. part. (κτάμενος), pass. sense, masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’slain’
κτείνων: κτείνω — kill, slay; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’killing’
κόλπον: κόλπος — bosom, hollow, gulf (of the sea); masc. acc. sg.
κύνες: κύων — dog; masc./fem. nom. pl. · also fem. nom. pl. used in address: ’(you) dogs’
κῦδος: κῦδος — glory, the lustre of success granted by a god; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., in apposition: ’glory’
λαιψηρὰ: λαιψηρός — quick, nimble; neut. acc. pl., with γούνατα: ’quick (knees)’ · also neut. acc. pl. used as an adverb: ’nimbly, quickly’ (λαιψηρὰ … ἐνώμα) · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with κέλευθα: ’quick (ways)’
λαοθόη: Λαοθόη — Laothoe, daughter of Altes and mother of Lycaon; fem. nom. sg.
λαοῖσιν: λαός — people, host, folk; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
λεχέεσσι: λέχος — bed, couch, bier; neut. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι (= Attic λέχεσι)
λισσόμενος: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat, supplicate; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.) · also = dat. μοι, elided, with a dat. adjective: ’to me’ (μ’ οἴῳ ἀμύνετε ’defend me alone’)

μέγ: μέγας — great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, elided (μέγ’ = μέγα): ’greatly’ · also neut. nom. sg., elided (μέγ’ = μέγα), with a noun: ’great’ (μέγ’ ἔρισμα ’a great cause of strife’) · also neut. acc. sg., elided, with a noun: ’great’ (μέγ’ εὖχος ’great cause to boast’) · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial with a superlative: ’by far’ (μέγ’ ἄριστος ’by far the best’)
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέλει: μέλω — be a care, be of concern (impersonal; dat. of the person, nom. of the thing); pres. 3 sg.: ’is a care to’

μαζὸν: μαζός — breast, nipple; masc. acc. sg.
μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)

μενεαίνεις: μενεαίνω — be eager, be set on (doing); pres. 2 sg., epic, + inf.: ’you are eager’

μεῖναι: μένω — stay, wait; aor. inf., complementing ἔτλη: ’to stand firm, to wait for’
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μνῆσαι: μιμνήσκω — remind; mid. remember, be mindful (+ gen.); aor. imper. mid. 2 sg.: ’remember!’

μοῖρα: μοῖρα — fate, portion, lot; fem. nom. sg. · also with an inf., ’it is fated’ (μοῖρα θανεῖν ’fated to die’)

νέῳ: νέος — young; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with μοι: ’(to me,) young’
νήπια: νήπιος — childish, infant; neut. nom. pl., attributive: νήπια τέκνα ’infant children’
νηυσὶ: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί)
νυκτὸς: νύξ — night; fem. gen. sg., gen. of comparison (after ἀμείνω) · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on ἀμολγῷ: ’of night’ (νυκτὸς ἀμολγῷ ’in the dead of night’)
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
νῶϊν: ἐγώ — I; dual gen./dat., epic (= Attic νῷν): ’for us two’
οἰμώξας: οἰμώζω — wail, groan aloud; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having groaned, wailing’
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’) · also enclitic dat. sg. pron. for a thing: ’on it, to it’ (ἐν δέ οἱ ἧλοι ’and on it studs’)

οἶος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg. · also οἶος printed for οἰός (οἶς) — sheep; gen. sg. οἰός: ’of a sheep’ (οἰὸς ἄωτος ’sheep’s wool’)
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὓς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: ’his own’; masc. acc. pl. (οὓς παῖδας ’his own sons’)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
πάντ: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl., elided (πάντ’ = πάντα)

παιδὶ: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. sg., after ξύν · also masc. dat. sg., indirect object of δόμεν: ’to her child’ · also masc. dat. sg., after περί, of place or concern: ’around’ (φίλῳ περὶ παιδί ’around his dear son’)

πολιόν: πολιός — grey, hoary; masc. acc. sg. (also neut. nom./acc. sg.)
πολλοὶ: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.
πολλοῖσι: πολύς — much, many; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic πολλοῖς)
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.; also adverbial, ’much, earnestly’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’many (works)’

πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’much, by far’

στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
στρατῷ: στρατός — army, host; masc. dat. sg.
σχέτλιος: σχέτλιος — cruel, ruthless, hard-hearted; masc. nom. sg., of a person or god

τίπτέ: τίπτε — why?; interrogative adv. (= τί ποτε), printed τίπτέ before με
ταχέες: ταχύς — swift, fast; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ταχεῖς)
ταχέεσσι: ταχύς — swift, fast; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι (= Attic ταχέσι)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses

τεθνᾶσι: θνῄσκω — die; perf. 3 pl. (= τεθνήκασι): ’have died’
τεῖχος: τεῖχος — wall; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’wall’
τηλεδαπάων: τηλεδαπός — from afar, far-off; adj., fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), agreeing with νήσων: ’far-off’

τούτῳ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. dat. sg.

φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φίλος: φίλος — dear, beloved; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’dear (to him)’ · also attributive, ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also masc. voc. sg., in address: ’dear (Menelaus)’
φανήῃ: φαίνομαι — appear; aor. subj. 3 sg., passive form, epic uncontracted (= Attic φανῇ, from φανέῃ), with ὅτ’ ἄν, general: ’whenever it appears’
φθίσει: φθίω — destroy, waste away; fut. 3 sg. act., transitive: ’will destroy’
φοῖβος: Φοῖβος — Phoebus, epithet of Apollo (‘bright, radiant’); masc. nom. sg.
φρονέοντ: φρονέω — think, ponder; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (φρονέοντ’ = φρονέοντα), epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονοῦντα)
φρονέων: φρονέω — think, intend, be disposed; pres. part. nom. sg. masc., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονῶν)
χέουσα: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’pouring, shedding’
χαλκοῦ: χαλκός — bronze, copper; masc. gen. sg.: πλεῖαι χαλκοῦ ’full of bronze’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on δοῦπος, of material: ’of bronze’ (δοῦπος … χαλκοῦ ’the din of bronze’) · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on στεροπῆς, of material: ’of bronze’ (χαλκοῦ … στεροπῆς ’the gleam of bronze’)
χαλκὸς: χαλκός — bronze, copper; also a bronze blade; masc. nom. sg.
χερσὶ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -σί (= Attic χερσίν)
ἀΐδαο: Ἀΐδης — Hades, god and realm of the dead; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic Ἅιδου)
ἀκέοντό: ἀκέομαι — heal, mend; impf. 3 pl. mid. dep., epic uncontracted, unaugmented, accented before the enclitic τε: ’were healing’
ἀλέντων: εἴλω (εἰλέω) — press together, crowd; aor. 2 pass. part. masc. gen. pl., epic ἀλέντων (= Attic ἁλέντων): ’of those crowded together’
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμολγῷ: ἀμολγός — milking-time (?); only in νυκτὸς ἀμολγῷ ’in the dead of night, in the depths of the night’, sense and etymology disputed; masc. dat. sg.
ἀνέρα: ἀνήρ — man; masc. acc. sg., epic ἀνέρα (= Attic ἄνδρα)
ἀνέσχε: ἀνέχω — hold up; intrans. stand out; strong aor. 3 sg. (stem σχ-, ἔσχον): ’stood out’ · also with acc.: ’held up’ (ἀσπίδ’ ἀνέσχε ’held the shield up’)
ἀνασχόμενος: ἀνέχω — hold up; mid. raise oneself, lift up one’s arm; aor. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised’
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; + acc. (ἀνὰ στρατόν ’throughout the army’) · + dat., ’upon’ (ἀνὰ σκήπτρῳ ’upon a sceptre’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis: ’up, aboard’ (ἀνὰ … εἷσεν ’set aboard’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ στόμ’ ἔχων ’having on your lips, going on about’ · also with σχέο in tmesis: ’back, up’ (ἀνὰ … σχέο = ἀνάσχεο ’hold back’) · also with ἀείραι in tmesis: ’up’ (ἀνὰ … ἀείραι ’raise up’) · also + acc. of place: ’up on’ (ἀνὰ μυρίκην ’up on a tamarisk’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ θυμόν: ’in the heart, in the mind’
ἀπεψύχοντο: ἀποψύχω — cool off, dry off; impf. 3 pl. mid., + acc.: ’cooled off, dried’
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’) · also adv. ’away, off’ before πρό (ἀπὸ πρὸ νεῶν ’off in front of the ships’) · also + gen. of manner: ’from’ (ἀπὸ σπουδῆς ’in earnest’) · also with a noun in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπὸ νευρῆφιν ’from the string’)
ἀρίζηλοι: ἀρίζηλος — very clear, conspicuous; adj. of two endings, fem. nom. pl., agreeing with αὐγαί
ἀργαλέῃ: ἀργαλέος — hard, grievous, painful; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ
ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀσπερχὲς: ἀσπερχής — without pause, vehement; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’unceasingly’
ἀστέρ: ἀστήρ — star; masc. dat. sg., elided (ἀστέρ’ = ἀστέρι), after ἐναλίγκιον
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχιλεὺς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. nom. sg., by-form with single -λ- (Ἀχιλεύς)
ἀχιλλεύς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀχιλῆϊ: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. dat. sg., single-λ epic (= Attic Ἀχιλλεῖ)
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’) · also modal particle with the subj. in a general relative clause: ’whomever’ (ὃν … ἂν … νοήσω ’whomever I notice’) · also modal particle ἄν with an infinitive in reported speech, keeping the ’would’ of the direct words: ’he said he would’ (ἂν … ἔφη παραμυθήσασθαι) · also ἂν = ἀνά before ν, prep. + acc.: ’up through’ (ἂν νέκυας ’up through the corpses’) · also with ὡς + subj. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν … τιμήσομεν ’so that we may honour’)
ἄλγος: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom. sg.
ἄλλοισι: ἄλλος — other; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις) · also neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι, agreeing with κτεάτεσσιν: ’the other (possessions)’
ἄμβροτον: ἄμβροτος — deathless, immortal (ἀ- + βροτός); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἄμοτον: ἄμοτον — insatiably, unceasingly, eagerly; adv. (neut. acc. of ἄμοτος)
ἄμυνε: ἀμύνω — ward off, keep off; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἤμυνε): ’warded off’
ἄνευθε: ἄνευθε(ν) — apart from, without; prep. + gen., epic (= Attic ἄνευ)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρηϊ: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρει)
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἄχος: ἄχος — grief, pain, distress; neut. nom. sg.
ἆσσον: ἆσσον — nearer, closer; adv., comparative of ἄγχι
ἐβεβήκει: βαίνω — go, step; plpf. 3 sg. act., with simple past force: ’had set out, was gone’
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’) · also in παρ’ ἐκ (= παρέκ) + acc.: ’beyond’ (παρ’ ἐκ νόον ’beyond reason’)
ἐλέησον: ἐλεέω — pity, have mercy on; aor. imper. act. 2 sg.: ’take pity on’
ἐλεεινὰ: ἐλεεινός — pitiable, piteous; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’pitiably’
ἐμοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., stressed (non-enclitic): ’to me’
ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’my’ (ὄνομ’ … ἐμὸν ’my name’; ἐμὸν κῆρ ’my heart’) · also neut. voc. sg., in address: ’my’ (τέκνον ἐμὸν ’my child’)
ἐμῷ: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. sg. · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with κάρητι: ’my own’ · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with δουρί: ’my’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδε: ἐνθάδε — hither, to this place; adv. of motion · also ’here, in this place’ (ἐνθάδε μιμνόντεσσι ’for those who stay here’)
ἐντὸς: ἐντός — within, inside; adv., or prep. + gen.
ἐνώμα: νωμάω — handle, wield, ply; impf. 3 sg.: ’was handling’ · also impf. 3 sg. with the limbs as object: ’set moving, plied’ (γούνατ’ ἐνώμα ’set his knees moving’)
ἐπίκλησιν: ἐπίκλησις — surname, byname; fem. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by surname’
ἐπίσπῃς: ἐφέπω (aor. ἐπέσπον) — follow up; meet, undergo (a fate); aor. subj. 2 sg. act., after ἐπεὶ ἂν: ’you have met’
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπεσσύμενον: ἐπισεύομαι — rush upon; perf. part. (pres. force) masc. acc. sg.: ’rushing on’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with πῦρ: ’rushing upon’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’) · also + dat. of respect: ’in’ (ἐπὶ φρεσὶ … κέκασται ’excels in wits’) · also + gen., of range: ’as far as’ (ὅσον ἐπὶ δουρὸς ἐρωή ’as far as a spear’s rush carries’)
ἐσθλῶν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; gen. pl., as a noun of persons: ’of the brave’
ἐστί: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg.; with a perf. part., periphrastic perfect: ’has been, is done’
ἐών: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐών (= Attic ὤν): ’being’
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑκάεργε: ἑκάεργος — far-working (epithet of Apollo; sense disputed, ’far-shooting’ is another guess); masc. voc. sg., in address
ἑστήκει: ἵστημι — set, stand; plpf. 3 sg. (perf. ἕστηκα): ’had stood, was standing’
ἑτέρηφι: ἕτερος — the other (of two); fem. sg. with the epic suffix -φι, instrumental (= Attic dat. ἑτέρᾳ): ’with the other (hand)’
ἑτέρωθεν: ἑτέρωθεν — from the other side; adv. with suffix -θεν
ἔγνως: γιγνώσκω — know, recognize; aor. 2 sg.: ’you recognized’
ἔγωγε: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε: ’I for my part’
ἔθηκε: τίθημι — put, place, cause, bring about; aor. 3 sg., augmented (root θη-/θε-, consonant-initial; unaugmented θῆκε): ’set, caused’ (ἔριν ἔθηκε ’set strife’)
ἔλθοι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. opt. 3 sg., in an indefinite relative clause: ’(whoever) might come’ · also after ὁππότε in past sequence, of an awaited event: ’should come’ (ποτιδέγμενοι ὁππότ’ ἄρ’ ἔλθοι ’waiting for when he should come’) · also after ἐπεὶ ἂν, potential: ’he would come’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg., in a clause of hoped-for outcome: ’might come’ (καὶ ἂψ … ἔλθοι ’and might come back’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after ἵνα μή: ’and he come’ (ὃ δὲ δεύτερος ἔλθοι ’and he come second’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a condition after εἰ: ’(if) he were to come’ (εἰ δ’ … ἔλθοι)
ἔνδον: ἔνδον — within, inside, at home; adv.
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειθε: πείθω — persuade, win over; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’was persuading’
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its relative with anastrophe (ᾧ ἔπι = ἐφ’ ᾧ ’for which’) · also ἔπι = ἔπεστι, ’is there’, verb with anastrophe (οὐ … ἔπι δέος ’there is no fear’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί placed after its noun, with anastrophe: ’at’ (πηγῇς ἔπι ’at the springs’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’to’ (νῆας ἔπι γλαφυράς ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’over’ (πόντον ἔπι ’over the sea’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί as a preverb in tmesis (ὦρσεν ἔπι = ἐπῶρσεν ’roused against’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, ’for’ (δώρῳ ἔπι μεγάλῳ ’for a great gift’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’at, against’ (Τυδεΐδῃ ἔπι … τόξα τιταίνετο ’drew his bow at Tydeides’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’by, along’ (ὁδῷ ἔπι ’by the road’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’at’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’at the hollow ships’, with ὀλέκονται) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + gen. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νήσων ἔπι ’to the islands’)
ἔσσεται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic doubled σ (= Attic ἔσται)
ἔστι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., accented ἔστι at clause start: existential, ’there is’ · also impersonal + inf.: ’it is possible’ (οὐδέ πῃ ἔστι … εὐχετάασθαι)
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
ἕκτορ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. voc. sg., in address · also masc. acc. sg., epic elided Ἕκτορ’ (= Ἕκτορα), object of σχήσουσι: ’Hector’ (πελώριον Ἕκτορ’ ’huge Hector’) · also masc. dat. sg., elided Ἕκτορ’ (= Ἕκτορι), after ἅμα: ’with Hector’ (ἅμ’ Ἕκτορ’ ἴσαν ’went with Hector’)
ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg., opponent after μάχομαι: ’with Hector’; and after χωρέω: ’to Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. after a verb of anger: ’with Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. with ὑπό, of those before whom men flee: ’before Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. with πειράω, the opponent: ’(make trial) with Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg., the person deprived: ’(taken) from Hector’
ἕληται: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid., after εἰς ὅ κε ’until’ (= Attic ἕως ἂν …); with ἐκ in tmesis, ’take out’ · also aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., with ἀπό in tmesis, in an indirect deliberation: ’should strip off’ (ἀπὸ … ἕληται) · also aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., in a temporal clause with ὁππότε: ’takes’ (θυμὸν … ἕληται ’take his life’)
ἕλκετο: ἕλκω — draw, drag; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic εἵλκετο): ’drew to himself’
ἠΰτε: ἠΰτε — like as, even as; epic particle introducing a comparison
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’) · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question (ἠὲ φυλάσσονται νῆες ’whether the ships are guarded’; ἠὲ κατ’ αἶσαν ἔειπον ’whether I spoke in due measure’)
ἢν: ἐάν (ἤν) — if (= εἰ + ἄν); conj. + subj.; ἢν μή ’unless’
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἰδέειν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. inf. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἰδεῖν): ’to see’
ἰλίου: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. gen. sg.
ἱδρῶ: ἱδρώς — sweat; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ἱδρῶτα)
ἴδεν: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= εἶδεν)
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἴσαν: εἶμι — go, come; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’went’ · also οἶδα — know; plpf. 3 pl., epic ἴσαν (= Attic ᾔδεσαν): ’knew’
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj. · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἵνα τ’ ἄνδρες … τελέθουσι ’where men become’) · also + opt., in a purpose clause after a past verb: ’so that … might’ (ἵνα μή … ἵκοιτο ’so that … might not come’)
ἵστασο: ἵστημι — set up; mid. stand, take one’s stand; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg.
ὀδύρετο: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn; impf. 3 sg. mid.
ὀδὰξ: ὀδάξ — with the teeth, biting; adv.
ὀλλυμένους: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be killed; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. pl., epic ὀλλ- (= Attic ἀπολλυμένους): ’perishing’
ὀξέϊ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic ὀξέϊ (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind, backward, afterwards; adv. (= ὀπίσω)
ὀρεγνύς: ὀρέγνυμι — stretch out, reach out; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
ὀφθαλμοῖσι: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
ὀχθήσας: ὀχθέω — be vexed, be troubled; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’vexed, troubled’
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὄχεσφιν: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. dat./gen. pl., old case-suffix -φιν (= Attic ὄχοις, ὀχέων) · also with παρά, locatival: ’beside the chariot’ (πὰρ … ὄχεσφιν)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction: ’in that, because’ (ὅ σφιν ἀμύνω ’in that I ward off from them’)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’) · also ὅς (τε) as an indirect interrogative without τις: ’who’ (ὅς τε πεφεύγοι ’who had fled’)
ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’how much, how far’ · also correlative with τόσσον: ’as much as’ (τόσσον … ὅσσον)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι), neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever’ · also with a superlative: ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’ · also conj. = ὅτι: ’that’ (after a verb of knowing, or ἅλις: ἅλις ὅττι ’enough that’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’) · also prep. + acc., place where: ’beneath’ (ὑπὸ γαῖαν ’beneath the earth’) · also prep. + φι-form of place: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ ζυγόφι ’from under the yoke’)
ὑψόσ: ὑψόσε — up on high, aloft; adv., elided ὑψόσ’
ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
ὠμησταὶ: ὠμηστής — eating raw flesh; masc. nom. pl.
ὠρίωνος: Ὠρίων — Orion, the constellation; masc. gen. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤμοισι: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ὤπασε: ὀπάζω — give, bestow (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg.
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’) · also ὥς accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τίς τε λέων ’like some lion’)
ᾤμωξεν: οἰμώζω — cry out in pain, wail; aor. 3 sg. act.
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥεθέων: ῥέθος — limb; neut. pl. limbs; gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ῥεθῶν)
ῥεῖα: ῥεῖα — easily, lightly; adv. (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
ῥηϊδίως: ῥηΐδιος — easy; adv. ῥηϊδίως: ’easily, readily’, epic (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
